title.value: Gotta Go Fast When Generating Data with Score-Based Models
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the main focus of the paper: accelerating the data generation process using score-based models.
title.quote: Gotta Go Fast When Generating Data with Score-Based Models

extractions.description: This paper aims to accelerate data generation in score-based generative models by developing a more efficient Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) solver that improves speed without sacrificing sample quality. The proposed method uses adaptive step sizes, reducing the number of score function evaluations, and leading to high-quality samples faster than standard methods. The approach showcases improvements across various image resolution tests.
